wholePhysicalScope: The September 2019 Duke University Chapel exterior with the 210-foot Gothic tower, cruciform nave, Duke family memorial chapel and the portions of the open cloisters immediately attached to the tower.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the 210-foot tower, main cruciform mass, chapel and open cloisters. Near levels add recessed lancets, tracery and pinnacles.
limitations: The named mapped footprint, tower base and tower height control principal scale. Individual upper sections, roof pitches, window tracery and attached cloister lengths are reasonable approximations.
The four original 2019 photographs guide the tower, transept, Duke Stone and open cloister. Fine sculpture and stained-glass imagery are simplified.
The original independent terrain is unchanged. Approximate entrance and foundation grades reflect the local field. Separately mapped campus buildings and interiors are outside the chapel asset.
